questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it is traveling slowly. You will see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, and horse-drawn wagons. During the day it looks like a solid orange triangle. At night it looks like a hollow red triangle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that lanes ahead are being reduced. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction areas. Drive carefully and be alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on roadways. You must come to a complete stop and wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs show you are near a school or school crossing. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers about traffic laws in that area. This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a curve ahead or that the road will become narrower. You may see several of these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you to traffic signals ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows your turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has sharp curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guards signals for you to go.
Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and be ready to stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is illegal to make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must obey. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagon sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at the intersection before entering. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance ahead. It shows the height distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to upcoming road curves. The road curves right first, then left. Slow down to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light is about to change to red.
The traffic light is about to change to green.
Stop and wait for traffic to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: The traffic light is about to change to red.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow light warns you that the signal is changing to red soon. Slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are already in the intersection, continue through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.
